Project in progress

Building a guarded ecommerce analytics copilot

This project connects reproducible SQL, a shared metric layer, and a carefully bounded natural language workflow for conversion analysis.

BigQuerySQLGA4 event dataMetric designAI evaluation

Scope before interface

Six supported question types

Overall session funnel, device conversion, acquisition context, category browsing to cart, time period anomaly comparison, and experiment recommendations based on supplied findings.

Guardrails

The assistant generates read only SQL and uses only approved tables, fields, and dates. It validates SQL before execution, shows the final query, and uses the metric dictionary as its source of truth.

Responsible narrative

Every narrative is labeled as an analysis draft. Descriptive evidence is never presented as a causal conclusion.

Why evaluation matters

The evaluation layer tests semantic accuracy, safe refusal, and SQL reliability against manually validated reference queries. This demonstrates quality assurance and evaluation driven AI development, not prompt writing alone.

Current next step: complete the reference analysis and metric dictionary, then build a question set covering supported, unsupported, and unsafe requests.
